name: Grade 7 IIT Practice: July Week 6 - Loops
description: Practice words for loops and timing.

words.example: The loop kept the character dancing until the music stopped.
Each iteration changed the costume once.
The repeat block made the sprite clap four times.

words.definition: Counting backward to a final number.
words.example: The countdown went from three to one before the game started.

words.definition: A repeated beat or timing pattern.

words.definition: To find and fix a problem in code.
